message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta. Noise violations are handled by the **Atlanta Police Department’s Noise Enforcement Unit** (often referred to as the “Noise Squad”). The city’s official portal and 311 system let residents report disturbances quickly and track the status of their complaint. --- ## How to File a Noise Complaint in Atlanta | Step | What to Do | Where / How | |------|------------|-------------| | **1. Gather Details** | • Date & time of the disturbance
• Exact location (address or intersection)
• Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, barking dogs, construction, etc.)
• Any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings) | Keep this information handy; it speeds up the process. | | **2. Choose Your Reporting Method** | • **Phone**: Call the Atlanta Police Department’s 311 line at **404‑656‑4000** (or dial 311 from any phone).
• **Online**: Visit the City of Atlanta’s 311 portal at and select “Noise Complaint.”
• **Mobile App**: Download the “City of Atlanta 311” app (available on iOS and Android) and submit a noise complaint. | All methods are free and available 24/7. | | **3. Submit the Complaint** | • Provide the details you gathered.
• If using the online portal or app, you’ll receive a confirmation number. | The system will route your complaint to the Noise Enforcement Unit. | | **4. Follow Up** | • Use the confirmation number to check status online or call 311.
• The Noise Squad typically responds within 24 hours of the reported incident. | You can also request a follow‑up call if you haven’t heard back. | | **5. Record the Outcome** | • Note the officer’s name, ticket number (if issued), and any citations or fines. | Keep this for your records or if you need to appeal. | --- ## Quick Contact Information | Agency | Phone | Website | |--------|-------|---------| | Atlanta Police Department – Noise Enforcement Unit | 404‑656‑4000 (dial 311) | | | City of Atlanta 311 Portal | 404‑656‑4000 | | | City of Atlanta Mobile App | N/A (download from App Store / Google Play) | | --- ## A Few Things to Keep in Mind 1. **Time Limits**: Noise complaints must be filed within **24 hours** of the disturbance. 2. **Noise Ordinance**: Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Title 10, Chapter 1 of the Atlanta Municipal Code) sets limits on decibel levels and quiet hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). 3. **Evidence Helps**: If you have audio or video evidence, attach it when you file the complaint. It can expedite enforcement. 4. **Follow‑Up**: If the Noise Squad doesn’t respond within 24 hours, call 311 again or use the portal to request a status update. --- ### Bottom Line Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the 311 phone line, the online portal, or the mobile app to file your complaint, and the Noise Enforcement Unit will investigate and take action if necessary.
